tidbit: Did you know… about 10,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google paused its open source bug bounty program. Confirmed by IT Pro: a significant rise in automated submissions, the vast majority of which are not valid.
A US appeals court rejected a fair use defense over artificial intelligence training. Reported by Music Business Worldwide: the ruling cited market and originality concerns in the labels' fight with Suno.
Google is limiting Gemini models' access for free and artificial intelligence Plus users starting October 9. Confirmed by The Times of India on MSN: free users are capped at Flash-Lite while paid tiers get higher usage limits.
Anthropic Claude models now get local inference in India via Amazon Bedrock. Confirmed by Business Today on MSN: this launch supports data-sensitive sectors.
OpenAI will show visual ads in ChatGPT while you generate images. Confirmed by bleepingcomputer dot com: the test targets 1.2 billion weekly users in the US.
Free every hour.
